after.PASSED and VALIDATED: proposed to the owner as a paper strategy of its own (rule 14), sized by the risk engine, followed forward on paper; never real money
after.otherwise: reported as it is; nothing changes

spec.data: Yahoo daily closes adjusted for dividends and splits; each file's sha256 in the manifest; a fund without the closes a month needs is no trade that month for both books

gates.costs_x2: mean monthly difference > 0 with the cost doubled
gates.t: t of the mean monthly difference (book net minus benchmark net), 2000..2017, >= the threshold
gates.top_year: no calendar year supplies more than 50% of the total difference

spec.holdout_rule: 2018-01..2026-09: mean monthly difference > 0 with one-sided t >= 1.645, and > 0 with the cost doubled
spec.question: do the three US sectors that rose most over six months beat all nine over the next month, after costs?
spec.rule: at each month's last close, the top three sector funds by six-month total return (ties by name), equally weighted, held for the month; the benchmark holds all nine equally; both traded back to their weights monthly
